_readme: Optional. Everything here is OPTIONAL — the hub works with this file empty.
Keys are game slugs (see data/games.json for the slug scan.mjs gave each game).
Anything you put here WINS over what was scraped from the game's HTML.
Any field you add that has values somewhere in the library automatically grows
its own filter rail on the wall. Add nothing and no rails appear. Example:
"restricted": true keeps a game in the repo and in the catalogue but off the
wall. It appears only when dev settings (Shift + F2, PIN) switch on
"Show all content". "hidden": true removes a game from the catalogue entirely.

1080-snowboarding-powder-rush-mirror-lak.description: Snowboard down to Mirror Lake in a race against rival Nova, a time attack for a gold target or a free ride, tucking for speed and landing grabs and spins.
1080-snowboarding-powder-rush-mirror-lak.controls: Left/right to carve, Up to tuck, Down to brake, hold Space to jump, Z to grab, X to spin

ac3-neon-skies-mach-and-mischief.description: Fly 36 operations in a corporate air war between Neuwork and General Resources, dogfighting with missiles and guns, striking ground targets and unlocking new airframes as your mission ranks improve.
ac3-neon-skies-mach-and-mischief.controls: W/S to climb and dive, A/D to turn, Space for missiles, J for gun, Shift to boost, X to brake, R for flares, Tab to switch target

ace-combat-sky-rascal-breakwater.description: Fly a jet over Port Meridian to knock out three radar sites, stop three bombers before they reach the port, then dogfight the enemy ace Red Kite.
ace-combat-sky-rascal-breakwater.controls: W/S to climb and dive, A/D to bank, Space for missiles, J for cannon, F for flares

armada-starflock-the-verdant-reach.description: Fly out from Haven Station to clear raiders, recruit a wingmate, upgrade your ship with salvage and destroy three swarm relays to expose the Warden carrier.
armada-starflock-the-verdant-reach.controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim and fire, Shift to warp, Space for nova, Q to scan, E to dock

battletanx-global-assault-tread-riot-las.description: Pick one of three tanks and smash through a Bay City blockade, destroying radio relays, taking down the Iron Bull heavy tank and escaping across the bridge.
battletanx-global-assault-tread-riot-las.controls: WASD to drive, mouse to aim, click to fire, Q for rockets, E for shockwave, Shift to boost

bionic-commando-hookshift-iron-canopy.description: Swing through a jungle fortress on a grappling cable with no jump button, clearing patrols and turrets on high or low routes to shut down Relay Spire 7's transmitter.
bionic-commando-hookshift-iron-canopy.controls: A/D to move and swing, W/S to reel, Space to grapple, F to fire, E to interact

bionic-commando-iron-tether-operation-br.description: With no jump button, fire a grappling arm at hardpoints to swing and climb a coastal outpost's two towers, shooting guards, calling HQ from the radio room and blowing up the base computer.
bionic-commando-iron-tether-operation-br.controls: Arrows or A/D to move, K or Space to grapple, Up to reel in, J to fire, E to use doors and radios

blade-runner-rain-check-the-street-of-ra.description: Search a rainy low-poly city for a missing courier across twelve cases, questioning neighbours, scanning for clues and building an evidence board, with small repair jobs, chases and grid puzzles along the way.
blade-runner-rain-check-the-street-of-ra.controls: WASD or arrows to move, E or Space to interact, Q to scan, J for casebook, B for evidence board, M for map, or tap a lead to walk there

blade-runner-raincheck-one-more-bowl.description: Play night courier Mara Venn in a rainy 2037 Los Angeles, talking with neighbours and following clues through one short story episode about a missing neighbour.
blade-runner-raincheck-one-more-bowl.controls: WASD to walk, E to talk, J for notebook, or click to walk

blast-corps-brick-blast-brigade-argent-t.description: Clear a path for a runaway nuclear missile carrier through Argent Towers by power-sliding the Swingback dump truck's armoured tailgate into the seven buildings on its route. For full completion you shove a block to reach the service tunnels, push TNT with a bulldozer, ride the subway and use a missile bike and a jet mech on the reinforced towers; Carrier, Demolition and Time Trial medals are saved.
blast-corps-brick-blast-brigade-argent-t.controls: WASD or arrows to drive or walk, Space for vehicle action (hold while turning to power-slide), Shift or F for alt action, E or Enter to get in or out, hold C for carrier view

blast-corps-brickblast-brigade-argent-to.description: Swing the Backlash's armoured rear into the seven buildings on a runaway missile carrier's route through Argent Towers before it rolls into them. For 100% you shove a concrete block off a stairway, push TNT with the Ramdozer, ride the subway, run a police car through a maze and use the Ballista's missiles and the J-Bomb's stomp to light 100 RDUs, flatten 14 buildings and rescue 8 survivors.
blast-corps-brickblast-brigade-argent-to.controls: WASD or arrows to drive or walk, Space for vehicle action (slide, fire, jets), Shift for turbo or stomp, F or Enter to get in or out, Q/E to rotate the camera

blast-corps-destruction-company-cinder-c.description: Clear a path through a small town before a runaway reactor carrier arrives, switching between a bulldozer, a drift truck and a jumping stomp machine.
blast-corps-destruction-company-cinder-c.controls: WASD to drive, Space to ram, drift or stomp, 1–3 to switch vehicles, E to use

bm-subterra-spark-vaultbreaker.description: Drive a crawler through the Cinder Aquifer, go on foot into Vault 03 to recover its phase capacitor, open the gate and destroy the M.O.L.E. excavation engine.
bm-subterra-spark-vaultbreaker.controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim, click or F to fire, Space to boost, E to mount or dismount

borderlands-2-outerlands-brinebreak-quay.description: Shoot through a frozen dockyard in first person to settle a debt, knocking out three relays and taking down Foreman Rime to open the vault.
borderlands-2-outerlands-brinebreak-quay.controls: WASD to move, mouse to look, click to fire, right-click to aim, Space to jump

br-before-the-rain-electric-sheepish.description: Walk rain-soaked city streets in first person as Holden, Deckard and the replicants, scanning scenes for clues, running Esper photo analysis and choosing between draft-script and film story routes.
br-before-the-rain-electric-sheepish.controls: WASD to move, mouse to look, E to interact, Q to scan, F or Space to act, Shift to run, C to crouch, Tab for journal

call-of-duty-4-modern-warfare-angel-of-d.description: Work the guns of an AC-130 gunship at night, using a thermal camera to clear roadblocks for a rescue convoy without hitting friendly vehicles or a protected clinic.
call-of-duty-4-modern-warfare-angel-of-d.controls: Mouse to aim, hold click to fire, 1–3 to switch guns, V for thermal mode, C to adjust the orbit

call-of-duty-modern-warfare-3-holdfast-l.description: Build a defender from weapons, perks and support strikes, then protect a relay against endless waves across a large field, grabbing supplies from outer posts.

choplifter-hover-and-out-desert-rescue.controls: WASD or arrows to fly, Space to fire, X to drop bombs, Q to turn

civilization-crown-and-clay-one-more-lit.controls: Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, Space to end turn, N for next unit

civilization-crown-and-clay-the-first-da.controls: Enter to end turn, Space for next unit, F to found or fortify, WASD to pan, Q/E to rotate

cobra-triangle-mamba-bay-small-boat-big-.description: Pilot an armed speedboat through three missions: race up Copper Canyon, rescue five crew in Castaway Cove, then sink the giant crab King Claw.
cobra-triangle-mamba-bay-small-boat-big-.controls: WASD or arrows to drive, Space to fire, Shift to boost, X for missiles

cobra-triangle-rattlewake-trouble-in-the.description: Drive a gunboat in three isometric stages: race up the river, rescue five swimmers before yellow boats take them, and shoot the sea monster Ironjaw's open mouth.
cobra-triangle-rattlewake-trouble-in-the.controls: WASD or arrows to drive, Space to fire, Shift for turbo, C for rockets

company-of-heroes-pocket-front-brickwate.controls: Tap or click to select soldiers and give orders; G, F, E and T for abilities

contra-rift-rangers-jungle-breaker.description: Run and gun through a low-poly jungle, pick the bridge or ground route, upgrade your weapon and destroy the bunker core before reaching extraction.
contra-rift-rangers-jungle-breaker.controls: WASD or arrows to move, Space to jump, J or click to fire, K for grenades

conways-game-of-life-emergence-signal.controls: Click or tap to place pieces, R to rotate, X to flip, Enter to confirm, drag to orbit, scroll to zoom

crash-bandicoot-mango-mischief-temple-tu.description: Jump and spin through four 3D jungle levels, from the coast to an old temple, collecting mangoes and sun shards on the way to the Sunstone.
crash-bandicoot-mango-mischief-temple-tu.controls: WASD to move, Space to jump, J to spin

crazy-taxi-fare-play-sunset-bay.description: Pick up fares around the hilly streets of Sunset Bay and rush them to their stops, earning tips for drifts, near misses and ramp jumps, or cruise freely with no clock.

crazytaxi-baybreak-cab-rush.controls: W/S to throttle and brake, A/D to steer, Space to drift

crystalis-aetherfall-windshard.controls: WASD or arrows to move, Space to attack (hold to charge), Shift to dash, E to interact

defender-of-the-crown-defender-of-the-cr.name: Defender of the Crown

defender-of-the-crown-defender-of-the-cr.controls: Click to choose orders, 1–5 to issue battle commands, Space to pause a battle or couch the lance

denteddestiny-z7.description: An original Souls-inspired pilgrimage through the ruined Bellwether Abbey. Fight deliberate melee combat, recover your death currency, unlock permanent upgrades and face Vesper, a two-phase bell guardian.
denteddestiny-z7.controls: WASD to move, J/K light and heavy strikes, Space to evade, Shift to guard, F to parry, R to lock on, X for the amber flask, E to interact

descent-down-six-axis-mine-combat.description: Fly a six-axis ship through a silent moon mine, find the blue and red access keys, rescue missing crew, destroy the reactor and escape before it blows.
descent-down-six-axis-mine-combat.controls: WASD to thrust and strafe, mouse to aim, Space/Ctrl to rise and fall, click to fire, right-click for missiles

desert-strike-mercenary-strike-first-lif.description: Fly a low-poly helicopter around an island, recovering supply crates past gun positions and armed vehicles, and land them back at camp to build your first base.
desert-strike-mercenary-strike-first-lif.controls: WASD to fly, mouse or arrows to aim and fire, Shift to boost, Space or E to take off and land

desert-strike-mercenary-strike-foundatio.description: Fly a voxel helicopter over a generated island region, collecting supplies and returning to base while paying the bills and growing a small mercenary company.
desert-strike-mercenary-strike-foundatio.controls: WASD to fly, mouse to aim, click to fire, R for rockets, Space to take off and land

desert-strike-skyshield-2026.name: SKYSHIELD: 2026
desert-strike-skyshield-2026.description: Fly a gunship through five long operations across desert, steppe, city and polar regions, destroying drone pickets, escorting convoys and holding landing zones, and stop at forward bases to repair and rearm.
desert-strike-skyshield-2026.controls: WASD to fly, Q/E to change altitude, mouse to aim, click or Space to fire, right-click or R for rockets, Shift to boost, X to repair at a FARP, M for map

donkey-kong-country-monkey-country-the-w.controls: Arrows or A/D to move, Space to jump, X to roll or grab barrels

doom-ii-hellshift-the-late-shift.controls: WASD to move, mouse or arrows to turn, click or Space to fire, E to use

dragon-quest-bramblebound-crown-of-the-s.controls: WASD to move, mouse to look, Space to strike, Q for whirlwind, E to mend, Shift to dodge

dragon-quest-crown-of-emberfall-attempt-.controls: WASD or arrows to move, Z, E, Space or Enter to confirm, X, M or Esc for menu

dragon-quest-crown-of-emberfall-attempt-.description: As a lone young warden, cross the old bridge to Cinderhollow, fight turn-based battles and defeat the Ashback Drake to bring the Dawn Shard back to King Rowan.
dragon-quest-crown-of-emberfall-attempt-.controls: WASD or arrows to move, Space or Enter to act

dragon-quest-ii-crown-and-comet-bellboun.controls: WASD to move, E or Space to interact, menu commands in battle

dragon-quest-ii-crownward-three-heirs.description: Guide three royal heirs along a monster-filled road to the ruined Skywatch, fighting turn-based battles to recover the Starstone and relight the beacon.

dragon-quest-ii-wyrm-and-wander-the-stol.description: Lead three heroes across a pixel-art kingdom, seeking the Moon Sigil, sailing to the Hollow Tower and defeating the Crown Wyrm to recover the stolen tidebell.
dragon-quest-ii-wyrm-and-wander-the-stol.controls: WASD or arrows to move, E to interact, I for items, K for magic, M for map

dragon-quest-ix-starfall-pilgrims-bellro.description: Take Elder Nessa's errand in Bellroot Vale, beat a road monster, buy gear and win a turn-based fight with the Moonbell Guardian to ring the shrine bell again.
dragon-quest-ix-starfall-pilgrims-bellro.controls: WASD or arrows to move, E or Space to interact, drag to turn the camera

dragon-quest-ix-starward-errand-bellholl.description: Help Warden Nella restore Bellhollow's Sunbell: fight meadow monsters in turn-based battles, buy gear from Bram and beat the Bellbreaker Beetle at Old Skywatch.
dragon-quest-ix-starward-errand-bellholl.controls: WASD or arrows to move, E to interact, 1–4 for battle commands

dragon-quest-lantern-road-bell-of-the-br.description: Guide Ari up a 3D country road to relight the hill beacon, opening chests and fighting road creatures in turn-based battles before facing the Bellhorn Warden.
dragon-quest-lantern-road-bell-of-the-br.controls: WASD or arrows to move, Space or E to talk and interact; battles use on-screen commands

dragon-quest-sunshard-quest-road-to-star.description: Cross the old road and climb Starwatch Tower in a small 3D adventure, talking to villagers, opening chests and fighting turn-based battles to bring Bramblewick's light home.
dragon-quest-sunshard-quest-road-to-star.controls: WASD or arrows to move, E or Enter to interact

dragon-quest-sunward-saga-the-verdant-tr.description: Cross Amberwind Vale with Rook and Mallow in a low-poly JRPG, fighting turn-based battles on the way to Mistfall Grotto to recover the Dawn Prism.
dragon-quest-sunward-saga-the-verdant-tr.controls: WASD to move, mouse drag or Left/Right to turn, E or Space to interact

dragon-quest-tumblecrown-the-mossglass-q.description: Help Pip recover the Mossglass crystal for Sunmeadow's festival bell, crossing clover hills into a grotto and fighting turn-based battles with herbs and Gale Cut.
dragon-quest-tumblecrown-the-mossglass-q.controls: WASD to move, drag the mouse to turn, E to interact, Shift to dash

dragon-quest-v-wyrmward-v-hearth-and-hol.description: Explore Bramblewick and Echo Hollow in a low-poly JRPG, recruiting a creature ally and fighting turn-based battles to bring a missing villager home.
